However, generative AI should only be used to help you, never to do work for you. Your instructor may set other rules about when and how generative AI can be used.

rows: 九大英単1. Make a plan for debate preparation in 3-member debate teams, i.e., 9 teams.
HW1. Learn to debate in a HEnDA style.
Practice mini debate on rice. Making a decision by debate.
HW2. Collect quotations to support the arguments (Briefs).
九大英単2. Building the affirmative case.
HW3. Write the Affirmative Constructive (AC) Speech.
Deliver the AC. Practice Cross-Examination (CX) and Attack.
HW4. Write the Negative Constructive (NC) Speech.
九大英単4. Deliver the NC. Practice CX and Attack.
HW6. Review your and your team's work.
Write a summary of the major arguments and your own evaluation of them.
